reference_prolog:
/*  Self-contained SWI-Prolog program
    State: Wisconsin
    Focus year: 2021

    Question: Is the bailiff an individual empowered by law to execute a writ of eviction?

    We model "writ of eviction" in Wisconsin eviction actions as the statutory "writ of restitution"
    under WI Stat  799.44 (2021).
*/

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
% Basic domain facts (scenario + identifiers)
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

% Scenario metadata
scenario_state(wisconsin).
scenario_focus_year(2021).

% The individual asked about
person(bailiff_1).
person_role(bailiff_1, bailiff).

% Minimal eviction/writ context (to ground the question in an eviction action)
county(dane).
writ(writ_1).
writ_type(writ_1, writ_of_restitution).
writ_property_county(writ_1, dane).

% This helper predicate "summarizes the scenario" as required.
% It succeeds exactly when the factual statement being evaluated is present:
% namely that the person is a bailiff and the writ at issue is an eviction writ
% (modeled as a writ of restitution).
scenario_statement :-
    scenario_state(wisconsin),
    scenario_focus_year(2021),
    person(bailiff_1),
    person_role(bailiff_1, bailiff),
    writ(writ_1),
    writ_type(writ_1, writ_of_restitution),
    writ_property_county(writ_1, dane).

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
% Statute encoding: WI Stat  799.44 (2021)
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

/*
  WI Stat  799.44(2) (2021): "the writ may be delivered to the sheriff for execution"
  WI Stat  799.44(4) (2021): writ "directed to the sheriff of the county in which the real property is located"
*/

% statute_799_44_writ_directed_to_sheriff(+Writ, -SheriffRole)
% Encodes that a writ of restitution is directed to the sheriff of the county
% where the property is located. We model "directed to" as the *role* sheriff.
statute_799_44_writ_directed_to_sheriff(Writ, sheriff) :-
    writ(Writ),
    writ_type(Writ, writ_of_restitution),
    writ_property_county(Writ, _County).

% statute_799_44_may_deliver_to_sheriff_for_execution(+Writ)
% Encodes that such writ may be delivered to the sheriff for execution.
statute_799_44_may_deliver_to_sheriff_for_execution(Writ) :-
    statute_799_44_writ_directed_to_sheriff(Writ, sheriff).

% legal_role_empowered_to_execute_writ(+Role, +Writ)
% From  799.44, the empowered executing officer (by this statute's text) is the sheriff.
legal_role_empowered_to_execute_writ(Role, Writ) :-
    statute_799_44_writ_directed_to_sheriff(Writ, Role),
    statute_799_44_may_deliver_to_sheriff_for_execution(Writ).

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
% Application to the scenario (reasoning)
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

% legal_person_empowered_to_execute_writ(+Person, +Writ)
% A person is empowered if their role is among those empowered by statute for the writ.
legal_person_empowered_to_execute_writ(Person, Writ) :-
    person(Person),
    person_role(Person, Role),
    legal_role_empowered_to_execute_writ(Role, Writ).

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
% Final answer predicate (deterministic yes/no)
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

housing_answer(yes) :-
    scenario_statement,
    legal_person_empowered_to_execute_writ(bailiff_1, writ_1),
    !.
housing_answer(no) :-
    scenario_statement,
    \+ legal_person_empowered_to_execute_writ(bailiff_1, writ_1),
    !.

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
% Main entrypoint (required)
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

main :-
    housing_answer(Result),
    format('housing_answer(~w).~n', [Result]).


:- initialization(main, main).

expected.question: Is the bailiff an individual empowered by law to execute a writ of eviction?
